title: ModelPNPS.jl: high-fidelity forward modelling of PNPS pulse-characterisation traces
description: ModelPNPS generates synthetic PNPS (Parametrized Nonlinear Process Spectrum) pulse-characterisation traces directly from the underlying experimental physics, by full spatially-resolved nonlinear propagation through the measurement medium using Luna.jl. Given an analytic or measured input pulse and an experimental geometry, it produces the trace a real apparatus would record — capturing spatial beam overlap and crossing geometry, mode shape, mask edges, chromatic vignetting of the signal, material dispersion, phase matching and the full nonlinear response. These ground-truth traces are intended for testing pulse-retrieval algorithms against a known input pulse and for developing new characterisation techniques. The currently implemented process is TG-FROG (Transient-Grating FROG).
